fixes.explanation: Working in the garden is a fair guess, friend. But the man's answer is, “I heard Your voice in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid myself.” He says nothing about work. He says he was afraid, and he says he was naked. That's the reason he gives for hiding.

Yes, baker! The text says He “…stationed cherubim on the east side of the Garden of Eden, along with a whirling sword of flame to guard the way to the tree of life.” Cherubim AND a sword of flame that whirls. I think the way back looks closed here, and that part is heavy. But the story isn't over.

problems.problem: Calling the selected answer an inferior excuse makes the missed answer the target of the joke.
The text says the cherubim and sword guard the way; it does not say nobody could sneak past them.
The security-team joke makes the cherubim and the sword guarding Eden part of the joke.
